_about: The address the backend may be told to listen on (Settings -> 'Let my phone reach this', JARVIS_HUD_BIND). Read by three tests: commands.rs capture_tests (the desktop's validate_bind_address), backend/test_loopback_too.py (which binds a REAL socket to every every_interface entry to prove the OS reads it as 0.0.0.0, then checks the backend patch agrees), and tests/tailscale.mjs. Add a case here and all three check it.
